label: Discount reports
description: Discount and coupon usage for a single reporting period.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: Human-readable label for the reporting period.

fields.label: Period start
fields.description: When the period starts (shown in your local time).

fields.label: Period end
fields.description: When the period ends (shown in your local time). Orders from this moment on fall in the next period.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency the amounts are reported in.

fields.label: Orders
fields.description: All paid, non-cancelled orders in this period, with or without a discount.

fields.label: Revenue
fields.description: Revenue from all orders in this period.

fields.label: Subtotal
fields.description: Value of the items ordered, before discounts, shipping and tax.

fields.label: Discounts given
fields.description: Total taken off by coupons, promotions and other discounts.

fields.label: Discounted order revenue
fields.description: Revenue from the orders that had a discount.

fields.label: Discounted orders %
fields.description: Share of orders that had a discount.

fields.label: Discount rate %
fields.description: How much was taken off discounted orders, as a share of what they would have cost at full price.

fields.label: Discounted average order
fields.description: Average order value of orders with a discount.

fields.label: Full-price average order
fields.description: Average order value of orders without a discount.

fields.label: Previous period discounts
fields.description: Discounts given in the period of equal length just before this one.

fields.label: Discount change %
fields.description: Percentage change in discounts given compared with the previous period.

fields.label: Discount report summary
fields.description: Headline figures for this period. Hover the info icon on a figure for what it counts.
